data.summary: Friendly **SPEED FREEKS** attacks gain [**[LETHAL HITS](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**] against the marked enemy through the current turn. Once this unit shoots in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), choose an enemy unit it hit to mark.
